title: fix(plugin-chatbot): the AI Approvals inbox shows the error, not an empty queue, and a refused poll stops (objectui#11736)
body:
Fixes #11736

Clause-②: no. The exported `usePendingActions` and `AiPendingActionsInbox` option, return and props types gain or change no member, and no i18n key is added. A byte comparison against the base confirms this (see "Fence" below).

Implemented by the `domain:ui#1` dispatch, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01DrKzdPdyLLBW3qpZ4vtk7z`.

## What changes

On a deployment with no AI service, the open edition answers `501` on `/api/v1/ai/pending-actions`. The inbox showed the error alert and, under it, "No actions waiting", which reads as a live queue that happens to be empty. The hook also re-armed a fixed 5 s `setInterval` whatever the read answered.

- **`AiPendingActionsInbox.tsx`**: the empty state is an answer, so it now renders only when the read answered. The branch reads `rows.length === 0 && error ? null : ...`. A failed read leaves the alert alone. Rows, the skeleton and the alert are otherwise unchanged.
- **`usePendingActions.ts`**: the fixed interval is replaced by a `setTimeout` chain. `settlePoll` re-arms it after each read settles, according to one fault policy, `ListReadOutcome`:

| answer | outcome | next read |
|---|---|---|
| 2xx | `ok` | after `pollInterval`; backoff resets |
| no HTTP status (network error, unreadable body), `408`, `429`, `5xx` except `501` | `transient` | `pollInterval` doubled per consecutive failure, up to `max(pollInterval, 120 s)` |
| `501`, any other `4xx` (`401`, `403`, `404`, ...) | `refused` | none: the poll stops |

Every list read goes through `settlePoll`: the initial read, the timer tick, a manual `refresh()`, and the re-fetch after `approve` / `reject`. So there is one timer at a time, and a stopped poll restarts only when a read succeeds (for example the inbox's Refresh button) or when the hook's inputs change, which starts the poll over. Each read carries a generation number, so a read that outlives an unmount or an input change re-arms nothing. The 120 s ceiling was copied from `MAX_BACKOFF_MS` in app-shell's `sharedUserFeeds.ts`. The code comment says that nothing keeps the two equal.

- The poll effect now keys only on primitives (`enabled`, `pollInterval`, `apiBase`, `status`, `conversationId`, `limit`) and reaches `refresh` through a ref. Before, it keyed on the `useCallback` identity, which AGENTS.md commandment 10 bans.

## The PM's hypotheses, measured on `main` `5a2a6ab`

- **H1 confirmed.** The `rows.length === 0` branch never read `error`.
- **H2 confirmed, plus one answer.** The interval re-armed unconditionally. The status is not dropped: `call()` already sets `err.status = res.status` on the thrown error, so the classifier reads it there. No second parser was added.
- **H3: one in-repo caller.** `git grep -n "usePendingActions("` hits the inbox's call and the hook's own declaration and doc example; the positive control is that the inbox call shows up. `useHitlInChat.ts` imports only the `ApproveOutcome` / `RejectOutcome` types and does not poll. The hook is exported from the package entry, so an outside caller (the module header names a Studio traces panel) gets the same policy: it stops on a refused read and backs off on a transient one.
- **H4.** The fake-timer pins below cover the stop, the backoff, the reset and the live control.

## Tests

New pins. Reads are counted as `fetch` calls under `vi.useFakeTimers()`:

- `usePendingActions.pollFaultPolicy-11736.test.tsx` (16 cases):
  - `501`, `404`, `403` and `401` are each read once, and not again across ten intervals;
  - a manual refresh that succeeds restarts the poll, and one that is refused again does not;
  - an input change starts the poll over;
  - consecutive `503`s come at exactly 10, 20, 40, 80, 120 and 120 s;
  - `500`, `502`, `504`, `408`, `429` and a rejected `fetch` back off rather than stop;
  - a success after failures resets to 5 s;
  - live control: 200 reads every 5 s;
  - an unmounted hook reads nothing more.
- `AiPendingActionsInbox.errorReplacesEmpty-11736.test.tsx` (3 cases):
  - on `501` the server's message shows, "No actions waiting" is absent, and there is one read across ten intervals;
  - on a transient `503` the error shows without the empty state, and the empty state returns once a backed-off read answers `200`;
  - live control: a working endpoint with an empty queue shows "No actions waiting", and the poll keeps its 5 s cadence.

**Reverse verification.** Both legs ran from the committed fix, restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, and were proven by matching HEAD blob hashes and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The pins import the sources relatively, so `dist/` is not on the resolution path.

- Hook reverted to the base: landing proof is `settlePoll` 0 and the old `setInterval` re-arm line 1. Result: **17 failed / 3 passed**. The 3 that passed are the live controls, which must hold on both trees.
- Inbox reverted to the base: landing proof is the error guard 0 and the bare empty branch 1. Result: **2 failed / 18 passed**. Both failures are `expected ... data-slot="empty-title" ... to be null` with "No actions waiting" received, which is the carded defect.

## Gates, run on `74b6272` (the final commit; the tree was clean)

Builds and tests went through `os-verify-lock.sh`, and each exit code was captured before any pipe.

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-chatbot^...' build` → exit 0, `Scope: 9 of 47 workspace projects`
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot test` → exit 0, echoes `vitest run --root ../.. packages/plugin-chatbot/`, `Test Files 57 passed (57)`, `Tests 590 passed (590)`
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot type-check` → exit 0, echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists both new test files.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` → exit 0, `OK`
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` → exit 0, `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims` → exit 0, `No pending changeset names a file this change touches.`
- `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` → exit 0, `No test source names a pending changeset.`
- Re-derived from the diff:
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` → exit 0
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` → exit 0
  - `pnpm check:spec-symbols` → exit 0
  - `pnpm check:i18n-keys` → exit 0
  - `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys` → exit 0
  - `pnpm check:test-path-roots` → exit 0
  - `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources` → exit 0
  - `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers` → exit 0
- Lint, narrowed to the 4 changed source and test files: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` → exit 0, 4 files, 0 errors. The one warning is the pre-existing `any` on `let body` in `call()`. The population is the config's `**/*.{ts,tsx}` block, and `--print-config` resolves 116 to 119 rules per file. No file sets `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move another file's verdict through types. The repo-wide `pnpm lint`, the site build and the rest of the farm are left to CI.

**Fence.** Against base `5a2a6ab`, the `UsePendingActionsOptions`, `UsePendingActionsReturn` and `AiPendingActionsInboxProps` declaration blocks are byte-identical, and so are `src/index.tsx` and the `usePendingActions` signature. `packages/i18n` has no diff.

Changeset: `.changeset/11736-inbox-error-stops-poll.md`, a `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`.

## Acceptance notes

- The route is not gated on the AI surface. Triage ruled that out for this card, so the page reached by URL now shows only the tabs, Refresh, and the remedy alert.
- Observation from reading the code, not measured: the hook's `isLoading` starts `false`, so the first paint before the initial read's effect runs can show the empty state for a frame. Fixing it needs a return member or a different initial-state contract, which this card's fence does not allow. Carrier: none.
- Observation from reading the code, not measured: after a read fails, `items` keeps the last successful rows, so a failure after a success shows the stale table (with Approve and Reject) under the alert. The card is about the empty state only, and this behaviour is unchanged. Carrier: none.
- The console page passes the description "Polled every 5 seconds ..." to the inbox. That is still true while the endpoint answers. The text is outside this card's file surface and was not changed.
